description: This file contains a unit test class for testing the CandidateRejectionAPI, which is part of the Recruitment API in the OrangeHRM application. The tests include setup, mock configurations, and checks for methods like getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete.
